heading: top-center
name: 兩端出血的置中方形圖片輪播＋箭頭
desc: 左右貼齊畫面、四角圓角的區塊：上方置中標題組，下方是兩端都被畫面裁切的方形圖片輪播，箭頭按鈕疊在兩端項目上，最下方置中一顆按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是卡片，左右貼齊畫面邊緣，上下留邊；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。區塊上方置中放標題組：標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略。標題組下方是輪播，項目等寬、從畫面左緣延伸到右緣，中間約露出三個完整項目，左右兩端的項目都被畫面邊緣裁切；左右各一顆圓形箭頭按鈕，疊在兩端被裁切的項目圖片上、垂直置中於圖片，用來切換。每個項目無外框：方形圖片在上，圖片左上角疊一個小標籤，右下角疊一顆小圖示按鈕；圖片下方是標題，標題下方可放一排小圖示，沒有時省略。輪播下方置中可放一顆按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：一次露出一個完整項目並置中，左右兩側露出相鄰項目的一部分，被畫面邊緣裁切，可用手指左右滑動切換，不顯示箭頭按鈕。標題組與下方按鈕仍置中；區塊仍左右貼齊畫面邊緣、四個角做圓角。

en.name: Centered square-image carousel bleeding off both edges + arrows
en.desc: A section flush with both screen edges and rounded at all four corners: a centered heading group above a square-image carousel cropped by both screen edges, with arrow buttons over the end items and a centered button at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a card, flush with the left and right edges of the screen, with margin above and below; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) are rounded corners. Place the heading group at the top, centered: the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a description below; omit it when there is no content. Below the heading group is a carousel of equal-width items running from the left edge to the right edge of the screen, with about three full items visible in the middle and the items at both ends cropped by the screen edges; a round arrow button on each side overlaps the cropped end item's image, vertically centered on the image, and is used to switch items. Each item has no border: a square image on top, with a small label overlapping the image's top-left corner and a small icon button overlapping its bottom-right corner; below the image is a title, optionally with a row of small icons below it; omit them when there is no content. Optionally place a centered button below the carousel; omit it when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The carousel becomes horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: one full item is centered at a time, with part of the neighboring items showing on both sides, cropped by the screen edges; items are switched by swiping left and right, and the arrow buttons are not shown. The heading group and the bottom button stay centered; the section stays flush with the left and right edges of the screen with all four corners rounded.
